data_fields.name: height_check
data_fields.donor_constant: Z used only when both sides non-zero and not ignored

best_idea: A named district row in zone data (name, circle or polygon, sound, LOS flag) that the server diffs against each player's position to fire enter and leave events.
decision_why: Keep the district row and the enter/leave diff, but recompute membership every server position tick instead of every 2 s, enforce the 50-area cap at zone load, and take position from the server rather than the client packet.
acceptance: A server test moves a player across a district edge in 0.3 s and expects one enter and one leave event; a zone with 51 areas fails to load with a clear error; a targeted NPC spell inside a losCheck district is refused without line of sight.
